heroHeadline: FIFA Overrides Iran's Government — Infantino Confirms Iran Plays All US Matches at Vancouver Congress; Iran Government Has Not Reversed Sports Minister's Objection; 38 Days to Kickoff
heroSubtitle: FIFA President Infantino announced at the 76th FIFA Congress in Vancouver on May 1 that Iran will compete in all three group-stage matches on US soil — directly overriding Sports Minister Donyamali's April 30 'under no circumstances' statement. Iran's football federation president Mehdi Taj had been denied entry to Canada the previous day (IRGC ties cited by Canadian authorities) and missed the Congress entirely. Infantino's rationale: 'We have to unite. We have to bring people together.' The split is now structural: FIFA's governance framework recognizes football federations, not government ministries, as the formal decision-maker — but Iran's government has not reversed its objection and will have to allow the federation to submit the final 26-man squad by June 1. Palestine FA president Rajoub refused to shake hands with his Israeli counterpart on stage at the Congress. Houston became the latest host city to formally take over its World Cup stadium (NRG, May 1). Eder Militão is confirmed out of the tournament after hamstring surgery. Argentina's Messi is expected in the 55-man preliminary squad due to FIFA on May 11. USMNT roster announcement: May 26 in NYC. 38 days to kickoff at Estadio Azteca.
